This repetition reinforces the themes of time and memory, showing how the past continuously influences the present, ultimately leading to the inevitable decline of both the town and the family. The supernatural elements further emphasize this inescapable fate, suggesting that the characters are bound by forces beyond their control, mirroring the broader historical cycles.
